instructions:
1. Set up on the 45 degree bench with your feet in the footrests and one thigh against the pad.
2. Place one hand behind your head and the other on your waist.
3. Bend your knee and bring your opposite elbow toward it, twisting your torso.
4. Return to the start. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist from your core, not your neck.
2. Keep your hips pressed into the pad.
3. Move slowly and under control.

instructions:
1. Set your feet in the footrests and press your thighs against the pad.
2. Cross your arms over your chest and bend forward at the hips.
3. Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
4. Lower under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stop at a straight line; do not overextend the lower back.
2. Drive the movement with your glutes and lower back.
3. Keep your neck neutral.
4. Move slowly, no swinging.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and arms overhead.
2. Lift your upper back and reach your arms forward toward your heels.
3. Hold briefly.
4. Lower under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press your lower back into the floor.
2. Lift with your abs, not your neck.
3. Keep the movement slow and controlled.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands in fists.
2. Raise one knee while punching the opposite arm overhead.
3. Lower and switch sides, raising the other knee and punching the other arm.
4. Keep a steady rhythm. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight for balance.
2. Drive your knee up to hip height.
3. Exhale as you punch.

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Extend your right arm and left leg until level with your body.
3. Hold briefly, then return to the plank.
4. Extend your left arm and right leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips square; do not let them rotate.
2. Brace your core so your hips do not sag.
3. Move slowly and under control.

instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Extend your right arm and left leg level with your body.
3. Hold for 1-2 seconds.
4. Return to the plank, then extend your left arm and right leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core to keep your hips level.
2. Do not let your hips rotate or sag.
3. Breathe steadily through the hold.

instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Extend your right arm and left leg, then return to the plank and pause.
3. Extend your left arm and right leg, then return and pause.
4. Keep the pauses controlled. Repeat.
tips:
1. Reset your core brace during each pause.
2. Keep your hips square throughout.
3. Move slowly, no rushing.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
2. Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the right dumbbell to your shoulder.
3. Lower under control.
4. Curl the left dumbbell. Repeat.
tips:
1. Do not swing; keep your upper arms still.
2. Fully extend at the bottom of each rep.
3. Squeeze the biceps at the top.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend one knee and slide the other leg out to the side, reaching down to touch that heel.
3. Push back to standing.
4. Repeat on the other side. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
2. Keep your chest up and core braced.
3. Push through the heel of the bent leg.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
2. Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
3. Reach your right hand toward your right heel, then return to center.
4. Reach your left hand toward your left heel. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulders off the floor throughout.
2. Crunch to the side using your obliques.
3. Move under control.

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Lift your right leg straight back without arching your lower back.
3. Hold briefly, then lower.
4. Lift your left leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glute of the lifting leg.
2. Keep your hips level and core braced.
3. Do not let your lower back sag.

instructions:
1. Lie face down with arms extended in front and legs straight back.
2. Lift your right arm and left leg off the floor.
3. Hold briefly, then lower.
4. Lift your left arm and right leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with your lower back and glutes.
2. Keep your neck neutral, eyes down.
3. Raise your arm and leg to the same height.

instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of the band, holding a handle in each hand, palms facing in.
2. Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the right handle to your shoulder.
3. Lower under control.
4. Curl the left handle. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a neutral grip throughout.
2. Do not swing; keep your upper arms still.
3. Control the band on the way down.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
2. Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the right dumbbell to your shoulder.
3. Lower under control.
4. Curl the left dumbbell. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a neutral grip throughout.
2. Do not swing the weights.
3. Keep your upper arms still.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and curl your right heel toward your glutes.
3. Squeeze the hamstring, then lower under control.
4. Repeat with the left leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Bring the heel as close to the glutes as possible.
2. Keep your knees aligned and hips still.
3. Move slowly and under control.

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
2. Step your right foot up beside your right hand into a lunge.
3. Rotate your torso right and reach your right arm to the ceiling.
4. Return your hand and foot to the plank.
5. Repeat on the left side. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee over your ankle.
2. Brace your core during the rotation.
3. Move under control.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
2. Lift your shoulders and twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
3. Lower under control.
4. Twist to bring your left elbow toward your right knee. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist using your obliques, not your arms.
2. Do not pull on your neck.
3. Keep the movement slow and controlled.

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
2. Step your right foot up outside your right hand into a low lunge.
3. Return your right foot to the plank.
4. Step your left foot outside your left hand, then return. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee over your ankle.
2. Keep your core braced and hips level.
3. Move under control.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
2. Lift your right leg and left arm toward each other, reaching for your toe.
3. Lower under control.
4. Lift your left leg and right arm. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the working leg straight.
2. Press your lower back into the floor.
3. Lift with your abs.

instructions:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands wider than shoulder-width.
2. Pull up while shifting toward your right hand, keeping the left arm straight.
3. Lower under control.
4. Pull up shifting toward your left hand. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your elbow down to lead with the back.
2. Keep the straight arm extended along the bar.
3. Lower fully under control.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended forward.
2. Step your left leg back into a lunge while drawing your elbow back like an archer.
3. Push through your front foot to return to standing.
4. Repeat stepping back with the right leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee over your ankle.
2. Keep your torso upright and core braced.
3. Control the descent.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to your sides.
2. Make small forward circles with both arms.
3. Gradually increase the size of the circles.
4. Keep the motion smooth. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight at shoulder height.
2. Keep your core braced and posture tall.
3. Move smoothly and under control.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to your sides.
2. Make small backward circles with both arms.
3. Gradually increase the size of the circles.
4. Keep the motion smooth. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight at shoulder height.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades as you circle back.
3. Move smoothly and under control.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
2. Bring your arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
3. Open your arms back out to the sides.
4. Keep a steady rhythm. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms at shoulder height.
2. Squeeze your chest as you cross.
3. Exhale as you cross, inhale as you open.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
2. Bring your arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
3. Open your arms back out and press your chest forward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Keep a steady rhythm. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your chest as you cross and your back as you open.
2. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
3. Exhale as you cross, inhale as you open.
